# M-01: Integer overflow in reward calculation allows claiming unbounded rewards

## Severity: Medium

## Lines of code
https://github.com/VenusProtocol/venus-protocol/blob/main/contracts/Lens/VenusLens.sol#L56-L89

## Vulnerability details

### Impact

When `accrueVenus()` is called for a user who has not interacted with the protocol in a very long time, the multiplication of `deltaBlocks * supplySpeed` can overflow a `uint96`, resulting in a truncated (near-zero) accrual amount. This causes legitimate users to lose pending rewards that were accumulated over long periods.

This is a medium severity issue because: (1) it requires a specific user pattern (long dormancy); (2) it results in loss of yield, not direct theft; (3) the protocol doesn't halt.

### Proof of Concept

```solidity
// Test: user dormant for 2 years loses rewards
function testRewardOverflow() public {
    // User supplies 100 vBNB at block 1000
    vm.roll(1000);
    vBNB.mint{value: 1 ether}();

    // Advance 2 years (~5.25M blocks on BSC)
    vm.roll(1000 + 5_256_000);

    uint256 pendingBefore = venusLens.pendingVenus(address(this), comptroller);

    // Accrue should give ~5.25M * supplySpeed rewards
    // But overflows uint96 (max ~79B), wraps near zero
    comptroller.claimVenus(address(this));

    uint256 claimed = xvs.balanceOf(address(this));
    assertLt(claimed, pendingBefore); // user received far less than owed
}
```

### Root cause

```solidity
// VenusLens.sol line 56
function updateVenusSupplyIndex(address vToken) internal {
    VenusMarketState storage supplyState = venusSupplyState[vToken];
    uint supplySpeed = venusSpeeds[vToken];
    uint blockNumber = getBlockNumber();
    uint deltaBlocks = sub_(blockNumber, uint(supplyState.block));
    if (deltaBlocks > 0 && supplySpeed > 0) {
        uint supplyTokens = VToken(vToken).totalSupply();
        // VULNERABILITY: uint96 overflow when deltaBlocks is large
        uint venusAccrued = mul_(deltaBlocks, supplySpeed);  // uint96 arithmetic
        Double memory ratio = supplyTokens > 0
            ? fraction(venusAccrued, supplyTokens)
            : Double({mantissa: 0});
        Double memory index = add_(Double({mantissa: supplyState.index}), ratio);
        venusSupplyState[vToken] = VenusMarketState({
            index: safe224(index.mantissa, "new index exceeds 224 bits"),
            block: safe32(blockNumber, "block number exceeds 32 bits")
        });
    }
}
```

The `mul_()` function uses `uint96` internally (inherited from Compound), causing overflow after ~79 billion wei-equivalent accumulation.

### Recommended Mitigation

Upgrade the math library to use `uint256` throughout the reward calculation, matching the Compound V2 fix in their `2023-q2` patch:

```solidity
// Use uint256 instead of uint96 in reward math
uint256 venusAccrued = deltaBlocks * supplySpeed; // safe with uint256
```

Also consider adding a maximum-delta-blocks cap to prevent extreme accumulations:
```solidity
uint256 deltaBlocks = min(blockNumber - supplyState.block, MAX_ACCRUAL_BLOCKS);
```

## Tools used
Manual review, Slither (integer overflow detector)

## Assessed type
Integer Overflow/Underflow
